title: Decoded Issue #6 promo: 2026 in creative
hook: Decoded Issue #6 is out: what a year of ads taught us, 2026 in creative.
caption:
Decoded Issue #6 is out: what a year of ads taught us, 2026 in creative.

This year Meta rebuilt how it chooses which ad a person sees. Creative became the targeting. And a lot of brands kept making new looks for the same buyer.

In this issue we go back through the year and pull out what held up, what didn’t, and what we’d tell a growth team planning January.

No predictions dressed up as trends. Just what the ads said.

Read it, and if it’s useful, forward it to the person who writes your briefs.
